text:
Which statement explains why aluminium appears to be unreactive?
A
It is coated in an oxide layer.
B
It has a low density.
C
It is low in the reactivity series.
D
It is solid at room temperature.

options.label: A
options.text: It is coated in an oxide layer.

options.label: C
options.text: It is low in the reactivity series.

options.label: D
options.text: It is solid at room temperature.
